correctness.rationale: At q=2+sqrt2, r_c=q-log[q(q-2)], the exact f derivatives are f(q)=q, f_prime=-1, f_second=0, f_third=2/q. Analytic symmetric two-cycle equations have a nonsingular (-2,1/(3q)) derivative, forcing a unique local analytic squared gap. Implicit derivatives U_r=3q, U_k=0, U_kk=-3/2 and mean-shift equation prove the uniform asymptotics; positive flip cubic coefficient gives attraction. At zero detuning the even-return normal form z -> z-2z^3/(3q)+O(z^4) proves the critical n*z_n^2 limit 3q/2. Exact symbolic and numerical checker were replayed.
